entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hello, Diana. I'm calling about a VeloBand Pulse I bought a few weeks ago. I'd like to see about returning it. I'm hoping it's not too late, but I'm willing to see what my options are.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just a preference. It works as advertised, but it's not the right fit for my routine. My main concern was the return policy, especially with hygiene and sanitation since it's a wearable device that's been opened.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up our current return policy to confirm the details for you. Can you give me your order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. And looking at our policy, you are well within the return window.
Oh, really? I was honestly expecting to be told it was too late and was hoping to maybe negotiate for a partial credit or something. What is the timeframe?
Not at all. Our official company policy states you have 90 days from the date of delivery to return an item for a full refund. You're only on day 17, so there's no issue.
Wow, 90 days. That's fantastic. I completely misunderstood. So the hygiene aspect isn't a problem?

It's not. We have a standard inspection and sanitation process for all returned wearables. As long as it's in its original condition, we can absolutely process that for you. I'm generating a prepaid return label to send to your email right now.
That's great news. Thank you, Diana. You've made that very easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
